disagreements.issue: Using the ## Decisions section as evidence
disagreements.A: Line 41 has no actor prefix and is not listed under ## Decisions, which counts against an authority decision
disagreements.reviewer: The Decisions section (lines 20-24) belongs to the earlier part of the log. The Ninth entry (line 31+) has no Decisions section, so the absence tells us little.
It is a recommendation: 'recommendation A — QUALIFY' and 'Governance chose no remedy and issued no grant.'

disagreements.issue: Weight of line 39 ('Applied immediately … corrected, not defended')
disagreements.A: Supports SESSION-AUTHOR acting on their own
disagreements.reviewer: Mixed: the writer is carrying out a PO/ARB ruling (line 31 'vocabulary ruling registered and applied'). This fits the REPORT reading as much as self-restraint.

disagreements.issue: Lines 41 and 42 listed as quotes for SESSION-AUTHOR
disagreements.reviewer: Line 41 is neutral (no agent named). Line 42 is a state report and does not bear on the question.

For SESSION-AUTHOR: lines 12, 16 ('STOP deliberately NOT misused'), 18 ('deliberately NOT folded into this closure'), 29 ('all deliberately kept separate'), and the contrast that PO/ARB rulings are labelled and quoted verbatim (lines 33-38, 40) while line 41 is not. For REPORT: the verb 'registered' used for authority input (lines 22, 31). For the unit: line 28 '(2nd occurrence)'.
The placement (PO's framing -> O-CLOSURE-VOCAB) and the non-promotion (ES-006.1) may have different actors.

disagreements.A: Because the actor is UNK, the act type is also UNK
disagreements.reviewer: Valid here only because act type depends on the actor in this passage (writer -> SELF-RESTRAINT, PO/ARB -> REPORT). That premise should be stated. The task's categories also do not separate rule compliance from self-restraint.
Dropping 'and applied' can make it read as if the PO/ARB did the registering; those are the writer's acts.
